invariants: Every ID is unique inside its registry.
Every attack references an existing live or graveyard hypothesis.
Every registered attack ID exists in the modular attack ledgers.
Every literature reference used by a hypothesis exists in references.json.
A reference support list may name only an existing historical hypothesis.
OPEN never means proved, probably true, or novel.
PROVED requires reproducibility R5 and an independently checkable proof artifact.
Destroyed and rejected hypotheses remain permanently addressable.
Mutually incompatible OPEN hypotheses are permitted and must not be presented as simultaneously true.
Every hypothesis numbered H030 or above must name an allowed proof role, a nonempty next gate, and at least two registered attacks.
Every hypothesis numbered H060 or above must name older derived_from parents and a material delta_from_parents matching its genealogy node.
Every hypothesis numbered H092 or above must appear in the current reverse-lineage ledger under each registered parent.
Matrix and cycle-pressure thresholds are loaded from this schema rather than duplicated in validator source.
Exact-alpha and SAT-label diagnostics may not appear inside canonical theta profiles or exact theta certificates.
A total-attack campaign must cover exactly every current live hypothesis and every declared protocol, while excluding all terminal shadows.
